name: integration-card
title: Integration card
description: A connected tool on a settings page: status in words, what it syncs, the last sync, and connect or disconnect with a confirmation and a retry.
docs: integration is { id, name, description, mark, syncs, account, lastSyncedAt, problem, consequence } and status is connected, attention or disconnected. The status is written as a sentence first (Connected as anna@studio.nl, Needs attention with the problem, Not connected) and the badge only repeats it. onConnect and onDisconnect may return promises: the card shows a busy state until they settle, and a rejection keeps the card where it is with the reason and a Try again button, and the result is announced. Disconnect asks in an alert dialog; consequence names what stops, or a default line about syncing is used. busy and error let you track a request yourself. A card fills its grid cell and keeps its buttons on one line, so cards with different amounts of text stay level; in a card narrower than 24rem Configure becomes the gear alone, with the word as its name. The last sync reads "12 minutes ago" once the page is live; pass now to fix it.
